svg.aria-label: Aswin Salish — AI-Based App Developer | Assistive Technology Developer | Creative Thinker. The camera descends onto a reef grown from the last 52 weeks of contributions; fish named after featured repositories swim past, plankton gathers into the name, and a depth gauge reads 475 metres, the twilight zone.
